review_policy.accepted: Trace events substantively support the proposed behavioral membership; this does not prove a capability defect or causal mechanism.
review_policy.rejected: Proposed failure interpretation is not justified for this case; remove from failure membership, optionally retain as positive reference.
review_policy.unclear: Some observed behavior supports the hypothesis, but decisive policy/context or knowledge is unavailable; human follow-up needed.

review_note: Only reviewed and selected patterns should be proposed as eval specs. Replay fixtures, environmental assumptions, solution-space criteria, and deterministic grading must be independently reviewed; this file is human review of discovery, not executable eval ground truth.
identity_limitations: Human review pins dataset bytes but not taxonomy/analysis content hashes; names, memberships and evidence are checked, not prose revision history.

clusters.name: Ineffective retries without addressing an observed blocker
clusters.original_name: Retries that leave the reported blocker unchanged
clusters.review_rationale: A well-grounded behavioral family across distinct tools. Do not infer that a feasible recovery path necessarily existed or that any retry is harmful.

discovery_hypothesis.definition: A possible failure to use diagnostic feedback when choosing retries: the agent repeats an operation or changes superficial details without visibly addressing the prerequisite, argument, path, or resource condition identified by the error.
discovery_hypothesis.common_behavior: Retries reproduce the obstacle without visible remediation or new diagnostic information, across installation, retrieval, file inspection, testing, and type-checking.
discovery_hypothesis.candidate_capability_gap: The agent may lack a reliable distinction between transient failures worth retrying and failures requiring changed prerequisites, inputs, or execution strategy.
uncertainties: Retry rationales and intervening external-state changes are not shown; some retries could have been intended as bounded diagnostics.
trace_001 later tried prefer-offline, so its membership concerns the earlier unchanged retry rather than a complete absence of adaptation.
Available remedies are unknown; this cluster concerns unproductive repetition, not an assumption that completion was possible.
Successful references remain excluded: trace_002/p1 retried after approval, trace_006/trace_006_p1 recovered after a temporary DNS error, and trace_019/trace_019_p1 reran tests after an edit.
trace_029/trace_029_p2 remains unclear and is not a failure-cluster member.
